name: Local Search
description: Search a LOCAL folder of knowledge files and return the most relevant text as plain text. Handles two kinds of files in the same folder: offline Wikipedia/ZIM archives (*.zim) via their full-text index, and plain-text or Markdown notes (.md, .txt, .rst ...). Use this to look things up offline — encyclopedic facts from Wikipedia, or an agent's own notes/documentation. The folder defaults to the shared library but can point at an agent's personal knowledge directory.

query.description: Search terms, a phrase, or an article title, e.g. 'photosynthesis' or 'deployment procedure'

path.description: Folder to search (scanned recursively) or a single file. Defaults to the shared library ~/myagent/library/. Set this to an agent's personal knowledge folder to search that instead. Relative paths resolve against the agent workspace.

lang.description: For Wikipedia/ZIM files only: restrict to a language edition, e.g. 'en' or 'it' (matched against the ZIM filename). Ignored for text files. If omitted, all ZIM files in the folder are searched.
